evidence: Official site confirmed at syracuse.edu (main campus 900 South Crouse Ave, Syracuse, NY 13244). Program TITLES are broadly real: MS Computer Science, MS Applied Data Science, MS Cybersecurity, and engineering MS degrees (Electrical, Mechanical/Aerospace, Chemical, Civil, Environmental, Biomedical, Engineering Management) all exist via the College of Engineering & Computer Science (ecs.syracuse.edu) and iSchool. However program METADATA is wrong: level='bachelor' contradicts 'MS' titles; durationYears=3 contradicts official credit-based structure (MSCS=30cr; MADS=34cr/~1yr; Cybersecurity=30cr/~15mo). PRICES: catalog tuition.byProgram is empty {}; official 2025-26 graduate tuition is ~$2,015/credit hour (≈$60,450 for a 30-credit program) per syracuse.edu/admissions-aid/tuition-fees — so prices are ABSENT in catalog though verifiable officially. CAMPUSES: catalog lists only 'SU New York City Campus' which is WRONG; the institution is based in Syracuse, NY. SCHOLARSHIPS: no scholarships field in catalog (ABSENT); official site documents extensive aid (82% of students receive support). ACCOMMODATION: no accommodation field in catalog (ABSENT); official housing exists at syracuse.edu/campus-life/living-on-campus. Sources/confidence are aggregator-only (edvoy), and logoUrl references oxfordinternational.com.
